scripts.check: node scripts/check-naming.mjs && pnpm --filter haquick typecheck && pnpm --filter native-demo typecheck && pnpm --filter haquick test
scripts.build: pnpm build:lib && pnpm --filter storybook build && pnpm build:site
scripts.build:site: pnpm --filter site build && node scripts/metrics.mjs --write && pnpm --filter site build
scripts.version:patch: pnpm --filter haquick exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:minor: pnpm --filter haquick exec npm version minor --no-git-tag-version
